home.seoText: Choose where you want to travel from and to, your dates and your preferred type of vacation. Browse listings and compare routes and budgets. Discuss plans in chat or post your own listing to find company for your next trip.
home.seoMapLink: Explore travel companions on the map

planning.question: How can I find a travel buddy for a vacation?
planning.answer: Start with your destination, approximate dates and preferred type of trip. Browse BlaBlaTravel listings and compare other travelers’ plans with yours. If you cannot find a match, post a listing with your route, dates and the kind of company you are looking for.

destination.question: Can I find a travel companion for a trip abroad?
destination.answer: Yes. You can search by departure country and city as well as destination country and city. Check that your travel dates overlap, then discuss the itinerary, accommodation and style of vacation before booking.

budget.question: What should I discuss with a travel partner before a trip?
budget.answer: Discuss your budget, dates, transport, accommodation and travel pace. Agree on which expenses you will pay separately and which you might share. Choosing the same destination does not always mean having the same expectations for a vacation.

contact.question: How do I contact a travel companion?
contact.answer: Open a listing, sign in and use the chat button if the author accepts messages. Introduce yourself and share your dates and plans. A call before traveling together can help you get to know each other.
